S4_BMP6.description: Table S4 (snp_F sheet), first block 'Estimated effect of BMP6 on the risk of endometriosis' (header line 2, SNP rows lines 3-12). Harmonised exposure (eQTLGen eqtl-a-ENSG00000153162) and outcome (ukb-b-10903) effects.

S4_SLC48A1.description: Table S4 (snp_F sheet), second block 'Estimated effect of SLC48A1 on the risk of endometriosis' (its own header on line 16, SNP rows lines 17-21, then a 'Note:' footer row).

Du2025CIMB-1.notes: The sheet stacks two blocks with no exposure column; the table is read from the BMP6 block header (line 2) and rows are selected by the rsIDs listed in that block (lines 3-12) so the SLC48A1 block below is excluded (no rsID overlap). Outcome ukb-b-10903 betas are on the linear (BOLT-LMM) risk scale, consistent with the reported OR 1.001002.

Du2025CIMB-2.notes: Read from the SLC48A1 block's own header (line 16); the rsID-format filter only drops the trailing 'Note:' footer row. Outcome ukb-b-10903 betas are on the linear (BOLT-LMM) risk scale, consistent with the reported OR 1.000723.
